# HDD (HRI Driving Dataset)

Instrumented real driving data with goal-oriented behavior examples and causal reasoning annotations.

## Example input and output

This is a source-grounded illustration of the task shape, not a copied or verified dataset row.

**Input:** Front-facing driving video with GPS and CAN-bus measurements.

**Output / label:** An observed goal-oriented behavior, such as a lane change; no separate future-intention label is asserted.

[Open the author-provided sample or demo](https://usa.honda-ri.com/hdd)

**Example evidence:** [official](https://usa.honda-ri.com/hdd), [paper](https://openaccess.thecvf.com/content_cvpr_2018/html/Ramanishka_Toward_Driving_Scene_CVPR_2018_paper.html)

## Intention in this dataset

Observed maneuvers and causal/context annotations support goal-oriented driver interpretation; this record does not assert an original prospective intention benchmark.

**Relevance:** `related` · **Origin:** `real` · **Year:** 2018

**Domains:** driver_behavior  
**Intention types:** driving_maneuver  
**Tasks:**   
**Modalities:** rgb, vehicle_telemetry, trajectory  
**Formats:** video, time_series, structured_annotation
